title: DECISION: Multiple independent size checks at different boundaries
description: Three size enforcements in fetch_with_https_client: (1) Content-Length header parsed upfront (lines 429-440), (2) Limited::new enforces hard limit during stream collection (line 445), (3) final post-collection check (lines 460-466). Not over-engineered — catches three distinct failure modes: lying headers, oversized bodies mid-stream, arithmetic errors. Prevents memory exhaustion and partial writes.
